isabel (People Ops): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring and org changes. I'll capture Qs here and ping leadership to answer. Please keep threads focused and short. link: https://redwood.co/handbook/reorg-notes :v:
aj (VP Eng): Appreciate this. Quick note: hiring prioritization doc is the source of truth for Q2->Q3; ask if something looks off and we'll triage by team.
connor (Dir Product): Can you clarify which product hires are considered "priority" vs "backfill"?
lena (Recruiting): Short answer: priority = revenue-impact or infra-critical roles (see bullets). Backfill = capacity-maintenance. I'm happy to post the list after this thread.
sam (Staff SWE): Any change to interview loops for the prioritized roles? We had the 2-1 loop for FE hires.
aj (VP Eng): No loop changes for now. We're experimenting with a faster funnel for emergent infra hires: 1-tech, 1-manager + short take-home. If it goes well we'll standardize.
nina (ML Eng): Will any ML/infra roles move from Hosted to Dedicated team ownership? We're worried about cross-team collaboration.
aj (VP Eng): Good question — core ML infra remains split. We're creating a small Platform ML squad to own KV caching and routing optimizations (3 FTEs specialist hires). They'll sit in Eng-Platform but embed with Eng-ML for the first 3 months.
isabel (People Ops): For clarity — headcount delta this quarter: +9 net (5 eng, 2 product, 1 recruiting, 1 support). We're reallocating 4 roles from "growth" to "infra" per leadership decision.
connor (Dir Product): How will the reallocated roles affect roadmap deliverables? Any timeline shifts?
aj (VP Eng): Two roadmap items will reprioritize: "dedicated autoscale" drops to Q4, "batching improvements" moves up to Q3. We'll share a short timeline update by EOW.
lena (Recruiting): To hiring managers: please refresh scorecards for any role you're owning. We need them to be interview-ready within 2 weeks to keep the timeline.
sam (Staff SWE): If managers don't have capacity to interview, can we tap core interview pools? We risk slowdown.
isabel (People Ops): Yes — Recruiting will coordinate a central interview pool for Q3 ramp. We'll publish availability slots and interviewers.
connor (Dir Product): Will there be manager changes or IC reorgs tied to these moves?
aj (VP Eng): There are two manager changes: Maria will move to lead Eng-Platform (effective 4/15). Her previous org will be split across two TLs. We'll post org chart update tomorrow.
nina (ML Eng): Any guidance on internal mobility? If I want to move into Platform ML, what's expected?
lena (Recruiting): Internal transfers welcome. Expect: a short interview with new manager + 1 peer loop. No external req needed; talk to your manager and People Ops.
sam (Staff SWE): Budget question: will the +9 net be funded from current FY or the new commit?
isabel (People Ops): Budget is from current FY reserves approved in last finance review.

isabel (People Ops): Thanks for the Qs — action items: 1) I'll post the prioritized role list (lena) by EOD. 2) AJ to share timeline tweaks by Friday. 3) Maria transition announcement tomorrow. If you have follow-ups, drop here and we'll loop in the right folks. :pray:
